CheckTitle: Ensure IAM roles do not have ReadOnlyAccess policy with cross-account trust
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices/Identity and Access Management
Description: Checks for roles with the ReadOnlyAccess managed policy that can be assumed from other AWS accounts.
Risk: ReadOnlyAccess exposes every readable resource (including S3 objects, secrets metadata and configuration) to external accounts.

Recommendation.Text: Replace ReadOnlyAccess on cross-account roles with narrowly scoped policies such as SecurityAudit or ViewOnlyAccess.

Notes: Not a numbered CIS AWS 3.0 control; mapped to 1.16 (least privilege).
